aurora.zh: Aurora 的 CT 方默认站位为 A1 M1 B3，占 33% 的枪局，胜率 43%。进攻开始后及时回防占 19%，低于其他队伍的 50%，回防调度偏慢。
aurora.en: Aurora's CT side defaults to A1 M1 B3, used in 33% of gun rounds with a 43% win rate. Only 19% of rounds saw a timely CT rotation, below the other teams' 50%, suggesting a slower defensive response.

falcons.zh: Falcons 的 T 方最常用 B 点爆弹：B连接烟、警家烟和 B后点火，10 次进攻赢下 8 次。NiKo 是最常摸边的人，有 8 次进攻时在另一侧或远离进攻点。
falcons.en: Falcons' T side most often executes B with Palace smoke, CT smoke and a Back site molotov, winning 8 of 10 attempts. NiKo is the usual lurker, hitting the other side or staying away from the entry on 8 attacks.

flyquest.zh: FlyQuest 的 T 方最常用 A 点爆弹，以天堂烟、A连接烟、A连接火和 A包点火组合，4 次进攻赢下 3 次。jks 是最常摸边的人，有 4 次进攻时在另一侧或远离进攻点。
flyquest.en: FlyQuest's T side favors an A execute using Heaven smoke, A connector smoke, A connector molotov and A site molotov, winning 3 of 4 attempts. jks is the usual lurker, hitting the other side or staying away from the entry on 4 attacks.

fut-esports.zh: FUT Esports 的 T 方快攻占 33%，高于其他队伍的 13%；CT 方开局前压占 32%，也高于其他队伍的 15%。CT 默认站位 A1 M2 B2，占 27% 的枪局，胜率 67%。
fut-esports.en: FUT Esports' T side fast-hits 33% of the time, above the other teams' 13%, while its CT side pushes early in 32% of rounds versus their 15%. The default CT setup A1 M2 B2 covers 27% of gun rounds with a 67% win rate.

g2.zh: G2 的 T 方快攻占 30%，高于其他队伍的 13%，但分兵进点仅占 29%，低于其他队伍的 59%，整体更偏向直接进入。CT 默认站位 A1 M2 B2，占 29% 的枪局，胜率 80%。
g2.en: G2's T side fast-hits 30% of the time, above the other teams' 13%, but only splits 29% of hits versus their 59%, showing a preference for direct entries. The default CT setup A1 M2 B2 covers 29% of gun rounds with an 80% win rate.

mibr.zh: MIBR 的 CT 默认站位 A2 M1 B2 覆盖 52% 的枪局，胜率 91%，是队伍最常用且胜率很高的防守布局。
mibr.en: MIBR's default CT setup A2 M1 B2 covers 52% of gun rounds with a 91% win rate, making it the team's most-used and highly effective defensive setup.

natus-vincere.zh: Natus Vincere 的 T 方拖后进攻占 62%，高于其他队伍的 36%，节奏明显偏慢，更多依靠延迟后的进攻创造空间。
natus-vincere.en: Natus Vincere's T side runs late hits 62% of the time, above the other teams' 36%, showing a clear preference for slower timing and creating space through delayed attacks.

pain.zh: paiN 的 CT 默认站位 A1 M2 B2 占 37% 的枪局，胜率 57%，是队伍最常用的防守布局。
pain.en: paiN's default CT setup A1 M2 B2 is used in 37% of gun rounds with a 57% win rate, making it the team's most common defensive setup.

spirit.zh: Spirit 的 T 方由 zont1x 负责最常见的摸边，6 次进攻时在另一侧或远离进攻点。CT 默认站位 A2 M1 B2，占 43% 的枪局，胜率 60%。
spirit.en: Spirit's T side relies on zont1x as the usual lurker, hitting the other side or staying away from the entry on 6 attacks. The default CT setup A2 M1 B2 covers 43% of gun rounds with a 60% win rate.
